title: User Registration with Payment
description: Verify that restaurant owners can successfully register with valid details and complete subscription payment via Razorpay integration.

steps.description: Navigate to the registration page.
Enter valid restaurant owner and payment details.
Submit the registration form.
Process payment through Razorpay gateway and complete payment.
Verify successful registration and subscription activation in the system.
Check that confirmation email or notification is received.

title: Login Success and Failure
description: Verify login succeeds with correct credentials and fails with invalid credentials appropriately.

steps.description: Navigate to login page.
Enter valid username/email and password.
Click login button.
Verify user is logged in and redirected to the Restaurant Dashboard.
Logout and return to login page.
Enter invalid username/email and password.
Click login button.
Verify login failure message is displayed and no unauthorized access granted.

title: Password Recovery with Rate Limiting
description: Ensure forgot password functionality allows email submission and implements rate limiting to prevent abuse.

steps.description: Navigate to forgot password page.
Submit valid registered email for password reset.
Verify password reset email is sent.
Submit multiple password reset requests from same IP within rate limit period.
Verify requests over limit are blocked and error message shown.

title: Menu Image Upload with Compression and Ordering
description: Test restaurant owner's ability to upload menu images with automatic compression applied and menus reorderable.

steps.description: Login as restaurant owner and open restaurant dashboard.
Upload multiple menu images with different sizes and formats.
Verify images are compressed to reduce size without losing quality excessively.
Drag and reorder the uploaded menu images.
Verify the new order is saved and reflected correctly on the menu display.
Attempt to upload images exceeding subscription limits.
Verify error or warning message is shown prohibiting upload beyond limits.

title: Unique QR Code Generation and Linking
description: Verify that each restaurant receives a unique QR code that links correctly to their digital menu page.

steps.description: Login as a restaurant owner and navigate to QR code generation page.
Generate a new QR code.
Verify the QR code image is generated and displayed.
Scan the QR code using a mobile device or QR scanner.
Verify that it opens the correct restaurant menu view page showing the digital menu.
Generate QR codes for multiple restaurants and verify uniqueness.
Ensure no QR codes overlap between restaurants.

title: Customer Bell Calling Feature
description: Test that customers can request waiter service via the bell button and that the restaurant owner is notified in real-time.

steps.description: Navigate to a restaurant's menu page via QR code.
Click the bell button to request service.
Verify customer receives confirmation of bell request submission.
Login as restaurant owner and open dashboard notifications.
Verify that the bell request notification appears in real-time.

title: Customer Feedback Submission and Display
description: Validate that customers can provide ratings and comments, which are then securely stored and displayed to the restaurant owner.

steps.description: Navigate to restaurant menu page.
Submit customer feedback including rating and comment.
Verify feedback is accepted and confirmation shown.
Login as restaurant owner and view feedback list in dashboard.
Verify customer feedback entries appear correctly with accurate ratings and comments.
Attempt to submit invalid or malicious input in feedback.
Verify system sanitizes inputs and prevents XSS or injection attacks.

title: Subscription Plan Upgrade and Renewal Payment Processing
description: Ensure restaurant owners can upgrade or renew their subscription plans and process payments securely through Razorpay.

steps.description: Login as restaurant owner and navigate to subscription management.
Select subscription upgrade or renewal option.
Make payment via Razorpay checkout.
Verify payment is processed successfully and plan status updates.
Verify webhook events from Razorpay update system records correctly (activation, renewal, cancellation).
Simulate payment failure during subscription upgrade.
Verify system reports failure and does not change subscription status.

title: Analytics Data Accuracy
description: Verify analytics tracking accurately records menu views and customer engagement without data loss or duplication.

steps.description: Access the restaurant menu page multiple times from different devices and user contexts.
Verify analytics dashboard reflects correct count of menu views for respective time periods.
Perform customer interactions such as feedback and bell requests.
Verify engagement data is recorded and displayed correctly in analytics.
Simulate network interruptions during analytics submit.
Verify no data loss and proper retry mechanisms if any.

title: Admin Dashboard User and Subscription Management
description: Test that admin users can manage user accounts, subscription status, and view audit logs with proper access control.

steps.description: Login as admin.
Access user management view and modify user active status (enable/disable).
Verify changes are saved and reflected immediately.
Access subscription management and modify subscription states.
Verify subscription status updates correctly.
View audit logs.
Verify logs contain records of admin actions with timestamps.
Attempt unauthorized access to admin pages.
Verify access is denied and user redirected or blocked.

title: SEO Metadata and Structured Data Rendering
description: Verify dynamic meta tags and structured data are correctly rendered on key pages for SEO optimization.

steps.description: Open public pages including Home, Pricing, Menu View, About, Contact.
Inspect page source and verify meta tags (title, description, keywords) are set correctly.
Verify structured data (JSON-LD) is present and valid according to schema.org standards.
Ensure no duplicate or missing SEO tags.

title: Custom Error Pages Display
description: Test that custom error pages like 404 Not Found and Session Expired display properly with user-friendly messages.

steps.description: Navigate to a non-existing route/page.
Verify 404 error page is displayed with appropriate message and navigation options.
Simulate session expiration during user activity.
Verify Session Expired page shows with correct message and login redirect.

title: Input Validation and XSS Prevention on Forms
description: Validate that all user input fields across the application implement proper validation and prevent XSS attacks.

steps.description: Attempt to submit scripts and HTML in input fields on login, registration, feedback, profile, and social links forms.
Verify inputs are sanitized and no script execution occurs.
Verify error messages or input rejections for invalid data formats.

title: Subscription Upload Limit Enforcement
description: Ensure menu upload limits based on subscription plans are enforced and users cannot upload beyond their limits.

steps.description: Login as restaurant owner with basic subscription plan.
Upload menu images up to the allowed limit.
Verify uploads succeed until limit is reached.
Attempt additional uploads beyond limit.
Verify additional uploads are blocked and appropriate message displayed.
Upgrade subscription plan and attempt uploads again.
Verify increased limits allow further uploads.
